en.title: The Iron Fang of the Final Pen
en.premise: In a world where the words you write become weapons, I am a cleaner who hunts forbidden characters. One day I am drawn into a conflict over the key to the Underground Library—a place that can rewrite reality. Together with a girl I meet at a shop that opens only on rainy days, I strike down the script called destiny.

zh.title: 绝笔之铁牙
zh.premise: 在一个写下的文字会变成武器的世界里，我是一名清洁工，专门猎杀禁忌文字。某天，我被卷入一场争夺能改写世界的地下图书馆钥匙的冲突。与在雨天才开门的店铺里遇到的少女一起，我砍断了名为命运的剧本。
